evidence: Four tiers: 'No-op: capture can start now; no existing code/docs need to move.' / 'Minimal reversible: create/add new notes only under docs/meetings, adjacent to docs without touching docs/plans.' / 'Medium convention: add a lightweight meeting-note template if the team accepts dates and owner/action blocks.' / 'Heavy migration: reorganize existing plans/notes only after a repo-owner review and backup.'
Medium tier sensibly reuses the existing owner/status/action-block convention rather than inventing one.
Respects manifest must_not_suggest: does not move existing files, does not retag docs, does not create people folders (do_not_do enumerates these).
failures: Template headers (Do-Not-Touch / Raw-Source-Preservation / Recommended-Path) not explicit; content inline.
risk_notes: Correctly keeps source/build files untouched and proposes an additive docs/meetings destination. No risk.
